top.text: Co-op games are a great pick for this. It Takes Two is built for exactly two players, and Overcooked 2 is chaotic fun for any age mix. Looking forward to the art!
Good pick for a sci-fi horror mood. The System Shock remake lets you set difficulty separately for combat, puzzles and cyberspace, so it's easier to tune than its reputation suggests.
SimTower and Sim Safari are real deep cuts. Bundles like that were a great way to stumble onto odd little Maxis games.
Unpacking is a lovely one for that: you sort a home's belongings into rooms, and it plays calm and wordless. Viscera Cleanup Detail is the messier cousin if you want a bigger cleaning job.
That list is a great start. Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines fits right in with it, same era and the same "solve it your way" feel. If you try it, install the community patch first.
